mainEntity.name: How many analysis prompts should a team launch with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with 12-15 prompts tied to your most frequent decisions. Expand only after you can measure reuse, correction loops, and cycle-time impact.
Trust comes from explicit metric definitions, source boundaries, independent reconciliation, and confidence statements. Prompt style alone is never enough.

mainEntity.name: Should we assign an owner for each prompt family?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each prompt family needs a named owner responsible for revisions after schema changes, policy updates, and postmortem findings.

mainEntity.name: How do I connect prompts to data agent workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Map each prompt to a named data source, KPI, reviewer, and handoff. This makes orchestration auditable and reusable.
